title: Evidence-Bounded Mental Health Reasoning from Heterogeneous Speech Protocols
abstract: arXiv:2608.31014v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computational mental health screening using multimodal speech and text has shown great promise. However, existing models often assume all clinical speech protocols carry equivalent evidentiary validity. In reality, heterogeneous protocols, from free interviews to fixed reading tasks, support fundamentally different evidence. Forcing uniform reasoning flattens these boundaries, causing models to hallucinate symptoms from irrelevant text or overclaim support. Even advanced long chain-of-thought LLMs fail to resolve this issue, as free-form reasoning can exacerbate boundary violations. To address this, we reformulate multimodal screening as an evidence-bounded reasoning problem. We introduce the Evidence Package Benchmark, integrating 1,870 packages across six heterogeneous sources with explicit modality masks and evidence permissions. translated_abstract: 使用多模态语音和文本的计算心理健康筛查已展现出巨大前景。然而，现有模型通常假设所有临床语音协议具有同等的证据效力。实际上，异构协议——从自由访谈到固定朗读任务——所支持的证据在本质上截然不同。强制进行统一推理会抹平这些边界，导致模型从无关文本中幻觉出症状，或过度声称证据支持。即使是先进的长思维链大语言模型也无法解决这一问题，因为自由形式的推理反而可能加剧边界违规。为解决这一问题，我们将多模态筛查重新表述为一个证据有界推理问题。我们引入了证据包基准，该基准整合了来自六个异构来源的1,870个证据包，并带有显式的模态掩码和证据权限。我们进一步提出了EviBound，一个协议感知的证据控制框架。与直接的大语言模型提示不同，Evi（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将多模态心理健康筛查重新表述为证据有界推理问题，提出了包含1,870个证据包、六个异构来源的证据包基准以及协议感知的证据控制框架EviBound，以解决异构临床语音协议下模型幻觉症状和过度声称证据支持的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates multimodal mental health screening as an evidence-bounded reasoning problem, introducing the Evidence Package Benchmark with 1,870 packages across six heterogeneous sources and EviBound, a protocol-aware evidence control framework, to prevent models from hallucinating symptoms or overclaiming evidence support under heterogeneous clinical speech protocols.
